verification.notes: The source-scoped transcript shows this is commentary, not a neutral report. Current coverage confirms that Erika Kirk appeared on the AmericaFest stage in a gold-sequin or glittering pantsuit and that a replica of the Prove Me Wrong tent existed elsewhere on the convention floor amid branded merchandise. The evidence does not establish that she was inside the replica tent while throwing merchandise, so the statement compresses distinct event elements into one scene. The phrase nobody knows why is subjective and cannot be fact-tested.
